list.subtitle: Chatbot flows answer customers on your official WhatsApp numbers with buttons, lists and media before the AI or the team steps in. Build a flow, publish it, then activate it.
list.deleteConfirm: Delete the flow "{{name}}"? Customers in the middle of it will stop receiving its messages.
list.empty: No chatbot flows yet. Create one to start.

builder.published: Published (version {{version}}). Customers get this version once the flow is active.
builder.activated: The flow is active and will answer customers.
builder.deactivated: The flow is off. Customers in the middle of it were released to the AI.
builder.notPublished: Publish the flow before activating it.
builder.unsavedConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?
builder.emptyHint: Drag a node from the list onto the canvas, or click it. The first node is where the conversation starts.
builder.desktopTitle: Open the builder on a computer
builder.desktopHint: The flow builder needs a wider screen. Open the inbox on a desktop or laptop to build and edit flows.

palette.dragHint: Drag onto the canvas, or click to add

fields.caption: Caption
fields.filename: File name shown to the customer

editor.carouselHint: Every card needs an image, and all cards must have the same number of buttons.
editor.mediaHint: Upload a file or paste a public https link.
editor.noApprovedTemplates: No approved templates yet. Create one in WhatsApp → Templates and wait for Meta's approval.
editor.templateGone: This template is no longer approved or was deleted. Choose another one.
editor.templateRepliesHint: Each quick-reply button of the template is an output. Wire it to the next step.
editor.startNodeHint: The conversation begins at this node.
editor.notifyTeamHint: When this node is sent, the chat is handed to the team and they get a notification.
editor.endSessionHint: Ends the flow after this node. On a node with buttons, choices left unwired end the flow and the AI answers.

settings.title: Flow settings
settings.triggerFirst: First message of a new conversation
settings.numbersHint: Choose which official numbers run this flow. None chosen means all numbers.
settings.noNumbers: No official number is connected yet.
settings.accountHint: How often a customer can get the flow again (Session TTL) and whether it runs during campaigns are set per number in WhatsApp → Accounts → Chatbot Flow.

test.title: Try it on a phone
test.hint: Starts the current version (even unpublished) for one number. It must have messaged you in the last 24 hours.
test.send: Start the flow on this phone
test.sent: Sent. Reply from the phone to walk through the flow.
test.outsideWindow: This phone hasn't messaged you in the last 24 hours. Send any message from it first, then try again.
test.invalidPhone: Enter a valid phone number with the country code.
test.noNumber: No official WhatsApp number is connected.

sessions.title: Recent sessions
sessions.empty: No one has gone through this flow yet.

errors.multipleStarts: Only one node can be the start.
errors.startAmbiguous: Mark the node the conversation starts at ({{count}} nodes have nothing leading into them).
errors.duplicateTitle: Two choices have the same text.
errors.listButtonRequired: The menu button needs a text.
errors.sectionTitleRequired: With more than one section, every section needs a title.
errors.ctaTextRequired: The link button needs a text.
errors.ctaUrlHttps: The link must start with https://
errors.cardButtonsRequired: Every card needs at least one button.
errors.cardButtonsUneven: All cards must have the same number of buttons.
errors.templateNotApproved: The template isn't approved by Meta.
errors.mediaRequired: Upload a file or paste its link.
errors.outputUnwired: "{{title}}" doesn't lead anywhere. Wire it, or turn on "End the session".
errors.outputBroken: Re-add the buttons of this node.
